_doc: Render-prompt rule base — the KNOW layer of the render-quality loop. Every lesson we learn (from a memory or a redo) lives here as a rule so it shapes the NEXT prompt before we spend a credit. Grows monotonically: layer 5 (LEARN) writes new rules here. check=regex is deterministic ($0); check=llm is guidance the pre-flight red-team + post-render verify apply. severity block|warn|note is ADVISORY (user rule: advise + auto-fix, human decides).

rules.message: describing TWO conflicting actions for the same limbs (e.g. 'arms nailed out along the beam' AND 'open hand presented toward the viewer') makes the model draw BOTH — a duplicate pair of arms/hands
rules.fix: state ONE unambiguous pose for the limbs; add an explicit count ('exactly two arms, one nail through each hand'); never mix a 'nailed-to-beam' pose with a 'reaching-to-viewer' pose in one figure

rules.message: the crucified Christ must have OPEN, nailed/pierced hands — the model keeps drawing CLENCHED FISTS gripping a rope tied to the beam (contradicts 'nails through his hands' AND the mercy-in-the-open-hand doctrine; a fist round a rope is not crucifixion)
rules.fix: PURE-POSITIVE (naming 'fist'/'rope' to forbid them DRAWS them): describe only the desired end-state — 'both hands OPEN and flat against the wooden crossbeam, palms facing forward, fingers relaxed and gently parted, a dark pierced wound in the centre of each open palm'. Never write the words fist, clenched, grip, rope, bound, tied.
rules.provenance: fft 02/05/06 roped-fist fail 2026-07-01 (user caught: 'loads of issues')

rules.message: a church / steeple / dome-with-a-cross in a 1st-century scene is an anachronism (the model drifts cross-topped domed buildings into the background)
rules.fix: describe only period-correct architecture: flat-roofed pale limestone houses, a city wall, no crosses or domes on any building; for distant Golgotha crosses name them as the two thieves' bare crosses only

rules.message: Roman 'lots' render as DOMINOES/tiles (medieval anachronism) when named as dice/tiles/game pieces
rules.fix: name them 'small carved animal knucklebones (astragali) scattered in the dust' — never dice/dominoes/tiles

rules.message: a free-standing burning candle on the ground at an outdoor daytime execution reads odd/anachronistic
rules.fix: drop the candle; light the ground scene by the storm-broken daylight or a low torch if a light source is needed

rules.message: a nailed-hand close-up drifts into wrong crucifixion geometry — the arm angles DOWN and the hand is nailed to empty space / a beam that doesn't line up
rules.fix: lay the arm straight OUT along the horizontal crossbeam (patibulum); nail the hand to THAT beam at the arm's end; forearm leads back to the shoulder; use ONE clear beam, not a confusing beam intersection

rules.message: crucifixion FEET drift non-biblical — the model lays both feet flat on a horizontal board/table and drives a nail straight down, which reads as feet resting on a table, not a crucifixion
rules.fix: the feet are affixed to the UPRIGHT post (stipes): both bare feet pressed against the vertical beam, one over the other with the knees bent to the side, a single hand-forged spike through both feet into the standing post; never a horizontal board or flat table under the feet

rules.message: a crucifixion NAIL renders as a HAMMER/mallet when its head is called a 'broad flat hammered head', and as a DAGGER when called a 'tapered spike' with an 'edge' — the tool-word wins over 'nail'
rules.fix: describe it as 'a single long slender iron nail, its thin square shaft driven through, only a SMALL nail-head showing' — never 'broad/flat/hammered head' (draws a hammer) nor 'spike/blade/edge/tapered' (draws a dagger)

rules.message: seedream has NO negative channel — naming a concrete noun to forbid it DRAWS it
rules.fix: delete the negation; describe the positive end-state (blank surface, healed skin, empty ground)

examples.good: (use the TEXT-FREE style variant; do not mention text at all)

rules.message: any mention of text/writing (even to forbid) renders as gibberish letters
rules.fix: use the TEXT-FREE style (STYLE without the 'NO text' clause); leave writing surfaces unmentioned

rules.message: PROVEN (probe #1, 10 variants): the WORD 'nail'/'spike' on a palm-forward hand ALWAYS renders a proud vertical nail standing OUT of the palm — head-shape words (round/flat/disc/square) only change its top; 'spike' adds an arrowhead; a two-hands macro adds finger-wire. ALL 8 nail-worded variants failed; BOTH wound-only variants (no 'nail' word) rendered a clean pierced hole.
rules.fix: PASSION pierced hand — DROP the words nail/spike/metal ENTIRELY and describe only the WOUND: 'a dark ragged pierced hole in the centre of the palm, dark red blood running down toward the wrist'. RISEN: 'one single round healed scar at the centre of the palm, smooth closed pale skin, flat and level' (also never say 'nail'; never 'puckered' → X-stitches). If a nail MUST appear as a separate object, show it lying flat or from the BACK of the hand, never on a palm-forward hand.
rules.provenance: PROBE #1 nail study 2026-07-01 (visual/_probe/nail/compare.html); seedream-no-negative-channel; fft 05/07/06c/01b redo fails

rules.message: welt/stripe/lash wording draws as X-shaped stitches
rules.fix: bruise-only: 'smooth unbroken skin with deep red and purple blotches'

rules.message: blind/closed-eye wording draws sunglasses
rules.fix: drop it; show infirmity via posture, a staff, or a guiding hand

rules.message: 'glow/light on the body' renders as neon glowing limbs
rules.fix: use 'plain even daylight' or 'a warm shaft of light falls across …'

rules.message: a hand/arm/limb shown alone reads as severed / disembodied
rules.fix: connect it: describe the arm continuing to the shoulder + edge of the torso, so it plainly belongs to the figure
rules.provenance: fft 05 detached-hand redo 2026-07-01; EW03 disembodied-hand defect

rules.message: large objects (cross, throne, altar, pillar) rendered floating unless anchored
rules.fix: state it is planted/driven/set into the ground: 'the upright runs unbroken to the earth, its foot set in a heap of stones and packed dust'

rules.message: 1st-century scenes drift a free-standing crucifix / church-style cross / modern religious prop into frame
rules.fix: do not mention 'cross' as scenery for ground scenes; for period scenes forbid nothing but describe only period-correct objects

rules.message: a cross reflected in water reads as an upside-down/inverted cross on a paused frame
rules.fix: keep the cross upright and solid; no reflection

rules.message: faces/dress/props drift modern / European / medieval
rules.fix: anchor 'ancient Near-Eastern, first-century, period-accurate'; Old-Master / reverent tone; no modern hair, cloth, or objects

rules.message: generic 'idol/shrine/statue' defaults the model to BUDDHA statues
rules.fix: name the exact culture (e.g. Greco-Roman, the god Pan for Caesarea Philippi)

rules.message: God/the Father must never be depicted as a figure
rules.fix: show only a high radiant light or the effect on people; the prayer is TO the Father, show Jesus + light

rules.message: PROVEN (probe #3+#4): a shared text descriptor holds only a FAMILY resemblance (ref-lock is broken); the face drifts most when mood/glory adjectives ('glorified/radiant/joyful/sorrowful') reshape it. STRUCTURAL marks tighten the lock; single SPOT marks (mole) drift/float and add a defect risk
rules.fix: use the EXACT same descriptor string every time (don't paraphrase); keep the FACE description NEUTRAL even in emotional scenes — carry the emotion in posture/hands/light/context, not face-reshaping words. Bake in STRUCTURAL marks (lean face, high cheekbones, aquiline nose) for consistency; do NOT add a mole/spot-mark — it floats off the cheek or jumps to the forehead

rules.message: a recurring character/object described fresh each time drifts (different face/world)
rules.fix: inject the canonical ref_library descriptor verbatim; for long-form attach the locked --image anchor

rules.message: supernatural eye wording renders unnatural/uncanny eyes
rules.fix: 'normal natural human eyes'

rules.message: figures rendered mid-stride get run BACKWARDS when the assembler boomerangs the clip
rules.fix: design an arrested/static pose (planted feet, standing, kneeling); atmosphere-dominant, locked camera

rules.message: veo/kling bloom particle words (dust/motes/sparkles) into an AI-glitter snowstorm
rules.fix: strip particle words; use steady-light wording, or a deterministic ffmpeg push-in for glory scenes

rules.message: generatively animating writing morphs the letters into garbled text
rules.fix: hold as a still or deterministic push-in; design text as illegible marks; keep text in PIL furniture, never in the render

rules.message: a push-in that gets boomeranged becomes a zoom yo-yo
rules.fix: boomerang fill needs a LOCKED camera + deep atmosphere; use directional/continuous clips for moving cameras

rules.message: PROVEN (probe #2): the model is reliably great CLOSE→EPIC-WIDE with ONE dominant subject, but extreme MACRO floats stray composites (a face in the hand) and 'busy/packed/dense/many elements' FRAGMENTS into a multi-panel comic page (even with the ONE clause)
rules.fix: compose close→epic-wide with ONE dominant subject; do NOT shoot extreme macro of tiny detail (shoot close instead); for crowded beats use one subject + a SHADOW/silhouette crowd + 2-3 props, never 'busy/packed with detail'

rules.message: dense/busy stills (many tiny faces, repeated detail) morph when Kling crop-cuts them
rules.fix: one dominant subject, ≤3 faces, crowds→shadow, negative space, no tiny repeated detail

rules.message: a motion COMIC must USE the layout vocabulary (splits, fractures, insets, grids, triptychs) for a viral/epic comic-page rhythm — an all-'full' single-bleed plan is a slideshow, NOT a comic (this is the failure that shipped: 13/13 beats were 'full')
rules.fix: assign a VARIETY of templates across beats: fracture a single dramatic clip into anchored crops (hero_frac3/4, split_v, hero_band3), grid multiple hook/build clips (two_v, stack_h, triptych_v, strip_h3, quad), use big_inset for a main+detail beat; reserve 'full' for the true HERO singles (the red-letter prayer close, the risen-hero landing). No two ADJACENT beats share a template. Target: >= 5 distinct templates, and 'full' on <= ~40% of beats.
rules.provenance: fft mocomic all-full failure 2026-07-01 (user: 'we must do all the template to make it viral and epic')

rules.message: a scene plan must NOT be mostly 'Christ in various poses' — it has to mine the narration's depth (the OT prophecy/type layer, the watching crowd + executioners, the human 'us', the cosmic response) or it fails to do justice to the text and the Bible study behind it. Failure that shipped: the fft pilot was 9/12 Christ-centric poses with NO Psalm-22 prophecy layer, NO crowd, NO executioner.
rules.fix: tag every scene with a subject_type (christ_hero/christ_detail/christ_risen = Christ-centric; context_scene/ot_echo/human_us/symbolic = the depth layers). Keep Christ-centric <= 60% of scenes; include >= 1 ot_echo (the OT prophecy/type, e.g. Psalm 22:18 'they cast lots upon my vesture'), >= 1 human_us, >= 2 context_scene; never > 2 consecutive Christ-centric scenes. Keep the three anchors (a nail/nailed-hands hook, the red-letter prayer FACE, the risen mercy-hero landing) but let the rest carry the study. Enforced by render_lint.verify.check_scene_subjects (run: python -m render_lint.verify --plan <scene_plan.json>).
rules.provenance: fft over-uses-Jesus-in-poses 2026-07-01 (user: 'we are not doing justice to the narration... just over using jesus in various poses')

rules.message: frame/border wording draws a picture-frame pillarbox inside the image
rules.fix: 'ONE single full-bleed illustration filling the entire frame, no border or divider'
